content.value_statement: SpecDD projects need tests that trace to active contracts. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through spec resolution and focused verification.
actual_capabilities: Checks that the target project has a root .specdd/bootstrap.md file.
Reads the active bootstrap chain in the required order.
Resolves the effective spec chain for a target path or behavior.
Identifies the nearest local spec that grants write authority.
Derives focused tests from Must, Scenario, Handles, Returns, Raises, Tasks, and Done when entries.
Reports which spec entries are covered and which behavior lacks verification.
limitations: Only applies to projects that already use SpecDD.
Does not adopt SpecDD for a project unless another skill is explicitly requested.
Requires clear test-file authority before editing tests.
Runs project tests only when a relevant test command is available.

use_cases.title: Add Contract Tests
use_cases.description: Turn active SpecDD requirements into small tests that verify observable behavior.

use_cases.title: Review Test Coverage
use_cases.description: Compare existing tests with governing specs and identify required behavior without verification.

use_cases.title: Create Regression Tests
use_cases.description: Use confirmed bugs and current specs to add focused regression coverage.

prompt_templates.title: Find Missing Tests
prompt_templates.prompt: Use specdd-test to review the tests for this target path. Report which SpecDD entries are covered and which still need tests.

prompt_templates.title: Add Focused Coverage
prompt_templates.prompt: Use specdd-test to derive the smallest tests for this behavior. Edit only files with clear SpecDD test authority.

prompt_templates.title: Assess a Change
prompt_templates.prompt: Use specdd-test to check whether my recent changes satisfy the active specs. Run the relevant project test command if available.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Regression Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Use specdd-test to map this confirmed bug to governing specs, add regression tests, and report any uncovered required behavior.

output_examples.input: Review tests for the payment retry behavior.
output_examples.output: The report identifies the governing specs, lists covered requirements, and names retry scenarios that still need tests.

output_examples.input: Add tests for the new validation rule.
output_examples.output: The result adds focused tests under authorized files and explains which SpecDD entries each test covers.

output_examples.input: Check whether this bug fix has regression coverage.
output_examples.output: The response links the bug to active specs, confirms existing coverage, or proposes the smallest missing regression test.

best_practices: Use the skill only after confirming the project has a root .specdd/bootstrap.md file.
Name the target path, behavior, or changed files before asking for test work.
Ask for a coverage report when you need traceability from tests to spec entries.
anti_patterns: Do not use this skill to introduce SpecDD into a project without explicit adoption work.
Do not ask it to edit tests when no governing spec grants test-file authority.
Do not request broad harness changes when focused behavior tests are enough.

faq.question: What does this skill do?
faq.answer: It helps derive, add, update, and assess tests from active SpecDD specs.

faq.question: Does it work outside SpecDD projects?
faq.answer: No. It requires a root .specdd/bootstrap.md file before the workflow should continue.

faq.question: Can it create tests automatically?
faq.answer: It can help add tests when the governing specs grant clear write authority.

faq.question: How does it choose what to test?
faq.answer: It derives cases from active spec entries such as Must, Scenario, Handles, Returns, Raises, Tasks, and Done when.

faq.question: Will it run the test suite?
faq.answer: It directs the agent to run the relevant project test command when that command is available.

faq.question: What should I provide in my prompt?
faq.answer: Provide the target path, behavior, changed files, or bug that needs verification.
